subject: Money
title: AI Bubble Debate
description: Learn AI Bubble Debate in one minute.

hook.text: Nvidia's stock rose 800% in 18 months after ChatGPT launched. The AI chip company is worth $3 trillion.

buildup.text: AI is genuinely transformative. But so were railways, the internet, and crypto. Each spawned a bubble.

discovery.text: Real technology + excessive speculation = bubble. The technology being real doesn't prevent overvaluation.

twist.text: Most AI startups burn cash with no clear path to profit. Sound familiar? It should. 1999 called.

climax.text: AI will change the world. The question is whether current valuations already price in decades of future growth.

punchline.text: The tech is real. The prices might not be.

quiz.question: Why might AI be in a bubble despite being real technology?
options: Current prices may already reflect decades of future growth
